botNoPermsMissingPerm:
I can't do that yet: the **{bot}** role is missing **{perms}**.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → **{bot}** → turn on **{perms}**, then try again.
botNoPermsRoleBlock:
I can't do that here: **{role}** is blocking **{perms}** in this channel.
To fix it: channel settings → Permissions → add **{bot}** and allow **{perms}**, then try again.
botNoPermsPrivate:
I can't see this channel, so I can't use it yet.
To fix it: channel settings → Permissions → add **{bot}** and allow **{perms}**, then try again.
botNoPermsUnknown:
Discord stopped me. Either I'm missing a permission here, or that person's role sits above mine.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → move **{bot}** above the roles I need to manage, and check it has the permissions this command needs. The **postcheck** command shows what's missing.
logSetPrivate:
AutoMod log set to {channel}, **but I can't see that channel yet.**
To fix it: channel settings → Permissions → add **{bot}** and allow **{perms}**.
logSetRoleBlock:
AutoMod log set to {channel}, **but I can't post there yet:** **{role}** is blocking **{perms}**.
To fix it: channel settings → Permissions → add **{bot}** and allow **{perms}**.
logSetMissingPerm:
AutoMod log set to {channel}, **but I can't post there yet:** the **{bot}** role is missing **{perms}**.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → **{bot}** → turn on **{perms}**.
hierarchyBan:
I can't ban **{target}**: their highest role, **{role}**, sits above mine.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → drag **{bot}** above **{role}**, then try again.
hierarchyKick:
I can't kick **{target}**: their highest role, **{role}**, sits above mine.
To fix it: Server Settings → Roles → drag **{bot}** above **{role}**, then try again.
hierarchyOwner: I can't do that to the server owner. Discord doesn't let anyone act on the owner.
hierarchySelf: I can't do that to myself.
botNoPermsGone: I can't find this channel anymore.
botNoPermsWrongType: I can't post messages in this kind of channel. Use the command in a text channel.
botNoPermsThreadLocked:
This thread is locked, so I can't answer here.
To fix it: unlock the thread or give the **{bot}** role **{perms}**, then try again.
botNoPermsTimeout:
I'm timed out on this server, so I can't act yet.
To fix it: right-click **{bot}** in the member list, remove its timeout, then try again.
logSetGone: AutoMod log set to {channel}, **but I can't find that channel.** Pick another one.
logSetWrongType: AutoMod log set to {channel}, **but I can't post messages there:** it's a forum, a media channel or a category. Pick a text channel instead.
logSetThreadLocked: AutoMod log set to {channel}, **but that thread is locked.** Unlock it or give the **{bot}** role **{perms}**.
logSetTimeout: AutoMod log set to {channel}, **but I'm timed out on this server**, so I can't post anything. Remove my timeout first.
